name: Edge Defect Laws and Ordering-Width Bound
statement: $\eta$ is nonnegative, vanishes exactly on daisy cubes, decreases under nonempty pc-minors, satisfies $\eta(C\times E)=|E|\eta(C)+|C|\eta(E)$, and bounds ordering width by $\sigma(C)\leq\max\{\eta(C)-1,0\}$.
proof: For a root $r$, the corresponding count is the number of missing cube edges directed toward $r$; minimizing chooses coordinatewise majority values. A distance-from-root order injects all but one coordinate of each minimal predecessor disagreement into distinct missing directed edges.
